# image2pdf v1.0.0 — Initial Release

First stable version of **image2pdf**, a fast, private, 100% client-side tool to convert, edit, redact and merge images into PDFs directly in the browser.

## ✨ Features

- **Convert & merge** JPG, PNG, WEBP, GIF, BMP and SVG images into a single PDF with [`pdf-lib`](https://pdf-lib.js.org/)
- **100% private:** everything runs client-side — no uploads, works offline
- **Image editor:** blackout redaction boxes + brightness / contrast / grayscale / sepia filters
- **Page options:** fit-to-image, A4, US Letter · portrait / landscape / auto · custom margins
- **Tiled watermark** text on all pages
- **Drag & drop** ingestion with native reordering and 90° rotation

## 📦 Assets

- Single-page app: `index.html` + local `pdf-lib.min.js` (zero build step)

**Full changelog:** [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/alkiory/imageToPdf/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
